# GHOSTKEY

> GHOSTKEY lets you use 200+ AI chat models through OpenRouter with one wallet, one balance and one API key. Before a request leaves our server, we remove your wallet, IP and device, and we only send it to providers on OpenRouter's public Zero Data Retention list. You pay what OpenRouter charges for each call. No markup, no top-up fee. 25% of every $GHOST creator fee becomes AI credit for holders ("Ghost Credit"), every hour.

Chain: Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663). Explorer: https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://ghostkeyai.com/): what GHOSTKEY is, with a chat box (10 free messages, no wallet needed)
- [Chat](https://ghostkeyai.com/app): the chat app
- [Models](https://ghostkeyai.com/models): every model with a zero-retention provider, with OpenRouter prices
- [Privacy](https://ghostkeyai.com/privacy): what we remove and the live request inspector
- [$GHOST](https://ghostkeyai.com/token): Ghost Credit, the hourly ledger, and a wallet checker
- [Roadmap](https://ghostkeyai.com/roadmap): what is shipped, what is live this week, and what comes next
- [Proof](https://ghostkeyai.com/proof): every claim next to a way to check it (works without JavaScript)
- [Docs](https://ghostkeyai.com/docs): API guide

## How it works
- Privacy: every request to OpenRouter is built in one function (server/privacy.mjs). It uses GHOSTKEY's shared key and fixed headers. Client IP, user agent, cookies, wallet, account id and the `user`, `metadata` and `provider` fields are never forwarded. Every request forces `provider: { zdr: true, data_collection: "deny" }`.
- Storage: the database keeps model name, token counts, cost and time per call. There is no column for prompts or answers. Signed-in users can download everything stored about them at /api/me/export.
- PDF chat: attach a PDF in /app (the page icon left of the prompt, or drag the file onto it). pdf.js, served from ghostkeyai.com itself, reads the text in the browser; the file is never uploaded and no OCR service is used, so scanned PDFs without a text layer are refused with a message. The text is sent inside the user message as `<document name="…" pages="N">[page 1] …</document>` followed by the question, and follow-ups resend it like the rest of the chat. Limits: about 50,000 tokens of PDF text per message with balance, about 25,000 on free messages, 400 pages, 30 MB. To check: attach a PDF, send, open "What we sent": the message holding the PDF text is marked "text of your PDF, read in this browser". The network tab shows no upload of the file.
- Personas: a persona is a name, a model and instructions, saved in the browser under `localStorage.gk_personas`, not in our database. In a chat that uses one, the instructions are sent as the first `system` message of each request, so they pass through our server to the model like any prompt, and are not stored. To check: open /app, Personas → + New, pick a starter, Save. The persona shows in the sidebar list and as a chip above the prompt, and `localStorage.getItem('gk_personas')` returns it. Send a message and open "What we sent": the first message is marked as your persona. If the browser blocks storage, the persona is kept for that tab only and the app says so.
- Web search: off by default. Chat: the Web switch next to the message box, one message at a time. API: add `"web_search": true`. GHOSTKEY then adds `plugins: [{ id: "web", engine: "exa", max_results: 5 }]`; client `plugins` and OpenRouter server tools in `tools` are dropped. OpenRouter runs the search at Exa and adds page text to the prompt; sources come back as `url_citation` annotations and in `ghostkey_receipt.web.sources`. Zero data retention covers the model, not the search: Exa keeps its own logs of the query. Cost: $0.007 per search plus page text as input tokens, both inside OpenRouter's usage.cost. Not available on free messages or Confidential models.
- Running build: GET /api/build lists every file in server/, web/, package.json and package-lock.json with its SHA-256, the commit it was deployed from and one treeHash. Recompute from the public repo: `git checkout <commit>` then `git ls-files server web package.json package-lock.json | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs shasum -a 256 | shasum -a 256`. Script: tools/verify/check-build.mjs. The hashes are reported by the server itself, not a hardware attestation.
- Confidential models: ids ending in `:confidential` (for example `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash:confidential`, `qwen/qwen3.8-27b:confidential`, `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017:confidential`) are routed only to NEAR AI, which runs them in hardware enclaves (Intel TDX + NVIDIA confidential computing). The request carries `provider: { zdr: true, data_collection: "deny", only: ["near-ai"], allow_fallbacks: false }`. The tag is shown only while NEAR AI's public attestation report (https://cloud-api.near.ai/v1/attestation/report?model=<id>&signing_algo=ecdsa&nonce=<64 hex>, no key needed) returns a model attestation for a fresh nonce; it is re-fetched every 30 minutes. The price is NEAR AI's own line on OpenRouter's ZDR list. To check one answer: press Check on its receipt; OpenRouter's record names the provider. The enclave covers the model side; the request still passes through GHOSTKEY's server like any other.
- Price: the amount billed per call is the `usage.cost` OpenRouter returns for that call. Each answer ends with a receipt that shows tokens, rates, cost and the exact (redacted) request we forwarded.
- Top-ups: USDG or ETH on Robinhood Chain to the treasury address, credited 1:1 in USD. Fee 0%.
- Ghost Credit: each hour the server claims the $GHOST creator fee from Pons. 25% goes to the treasury as the holder pool and 75% to the owner wallet. Holders with an average of at least the minimum $GHOST over four snapshots (:15, :30, :45, :60) get a pro-rata share as AI balance. Each hour is published as JSON and its Merkle root is posted to the GhostLedger contract.

## API (OpenAI-compatible)
- Base URL: https://ghostkeyai.com/v1
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer gk_live_...` (create a key at /account after signing in with a wallet)
- `POST /v1/chat/completions` (stream or not). Non-stream responses include a `ghostkey_receipt` field. Streams end with a chunk that carries `ghostkey_receipt`.
- `GET /v1/models`
- New accounts get 10 free calls on budget models.

## Public JSON (no login)
- [Config](https://ghostkeyai.com/api/config)
- [Models](https://ghostkeyai.com/api/models)
- [Stats](https://ghostkeyai.com/api/stats): numbers read from the database
- [Ledger](https://ghostkeyai.com/api/ledger): latest Ghost Credit hours; `/api/ledger/<hour>` for one hour, `/api/ledger/<hour>/raw` for its exact bytes
- [Holder](https://ghostkeyai.com/api/holder/0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000): credits and Merkle proofs for a wallet
- [Proof](https://ghostkeyai.com/api/proof): contract and wallet addresses with explorer links
- [Fee report](https://ghostkeyai.com/report): monthly fees claimed, holder and team shares, gas kept, Ghost Credit paid, and nine checks. JSON at `/api/report/<YYYY-MM>`, one CSV row per claim at `/api/report/<YYYY-MM>.csv`, months at `/api/report`. Re-check: `node tools/verify/month-report.mjs --month <YYYY-MM> --chain`
- `POST /api/inspect` with an OpenAI-style body: shows the exact request GHOSTKEY would send, without calling a model

## Limits
- Privacy covers who you are, not what you write. The model still reads your question to answer it.
- Zero Data Retention is the provider's policy, listed publicly by OpenRouter. OpenRouter screens for illegal content as the law requires.
- Your balance is held by GHOSTKEY's server as prepaid credit. It is not a token in your wallet.
- We keep your wallet address because top-ups and Ghost Credit need it.
- Ghost Credit is platform credit for AI, not money. It depends on how much $GHOST is traded. Nothing here promises a price or profit.
